name: Shanghai Alliance Investment Co., Ltd. (上海联和投资有限公司)
note: Shanghai municipal state-owned investment holding company, established 1994. Per Bank of Shanghai's 2025 annual report (cninfo, 2026-04-24), its controlling shareholder and actual controller is the Shanghai Municipal State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (Shanghai SASAC, 上海市国有资产监督管理委员会). It is Bank of Shanghai's largest shareholder with 14.73% (14.98% with affiliates and concert parties).
